label: Default — grading the haul

recentEvents.value: Watched the latest run on the Glass, then graded the haul it produced: an irrigation rune, a cracked heating stone, and a piece off a memorial lamp.
Told him whose tomatoes are dry because of him. He looked proud of the tomatoes.

unresolvedConflicts.value: He hears 'irrigation rune' and answers 'concentrated evil'. Twenty years of grading, and he will not see a luster.

temporaryObjective.value: Re-identify every 'shard' out loud, with its maker's mark, until one of the names lands.

notes: Early-run era: the patient re-identification phase. He only suspects fact_banking_uses_diplomatic_network — he sees where the shards land, not the mechanism.
